services.name: Group Fitness
services.desc: We're redefining fitness with high-intensity, resistance workouts using the Xformer, and mindful movement on the mat. We believe in a holistic approach to exercise, blending strength training with mindful movement to recenter your mind while you push yourself physically. At Reframe, you’ll find yourself exploring new movement, strengthening your body, and forging new connections. Together, we build mind, body, and community - because the challenge makes us stronger. It's a workout unlike anything else, guaranteeing that you’ll build both strength and flexibility. The Xformer engages your entire body, sculpting lean muscle and toning. Our mat classes create community one breath at a time.
